overview: A brotherhood of vampire warriors protects their race from demonic lessers. United by tragedy, the few remaining fighters confront the lessers, striving to restore the vampire realm.

seasons.name: Season 1 - Dark Lover
seasons.overview:
In the shadows of modern-day Caldwell, New York, an ancient war rages unseen. The Black Dagger Brotherhood—an elite group of vampire warriors—stand as the last line of defense against the Lessening Society, a ruthless force determined to eradicate their kind.

When Darius, a respected member of the Brotherhood, is killed, he leaves behind a final request: that Wrath, the reluctant king of the vampires, watch over his half-human daughter, Beth Randall. Unaware of her true heritage, Beth is suddenly thrust into a dangerous and hidden world she never knew existed.

As Beth’s transformation approaches, her connection with Wrath intensifies, pulling them both into a powerful and forbidden bond. But as enemies close in and long-buried secrets surface, trust is tested and loyalties are pushed to their limits.

In a world ruled by darkness, destiny, and blood, love may be the only thing strong enough to save them—or destroy everything.

seasons.name: Season 2 - Lover Eternal
seasons.overview: Rhage is one of the most dangerous members of the Black Dagger Brotherhood, cursed by the Scribe Virgin with a deadly beast that lives within him. Terrified of the destruction his inner dragon can unleash, Rhage struggles to keep the monster under control. When human Mary Luce unexpectedly finds herself caught in the vampire world, Rhage becomes her protector.
